pages: Good to see you again. What can I do for you?

New faces! Come in and warm yourselves.

I keep the inn, and an ear to the talk that passes through it. If you're heading below, ask before you go. A little advice costs less than a funeral.

Some come here to celebrate a discovery. Others just need a quiet seat and someone to listen. There's room for both.

Now, what can I do for you?
A roof, a fire, and a place to catch your breath. That's what I try to offer. Stay as long as you need; the dungeon will still be there when you're ready.
Sanctuary earns its name by keeping ordinary things going. Fires need tending and people need feeding, however much trouble there is beneath our feet.

Know when to turn back. A full pack is no use to someone who never reaches the stairs.

And mind your companions. The one who looks steady may be the one too proud to ask for a rest.
I've heard plenty of grand claims over a mug. Before we get to those, ask me about the dungeon. Sensible advice is a better place to start.

Since you're willing to listen to advice, here's another piece: don't let someone else's tale choose your risks for you.

A story grows every time it's told. The stairs don't get any closer.
Have you heard anything of Gwendolyn? Then tell me!
You there! Adventurers! My daughter Gwendolyn was kidnapped last night. Monsters came up from the dungeon beneath Sanctuary and carried her away!

My beautiful daughter, dragged into that wretched place! Find her and bring her home safely. Boric and Balin are assisting me with the investigation. Their principal contribution so far has been standing there.
My daughter! Beautiful, headstrong, and quite capable of telling me when I am being unreasonable. Which she does far too often. Bring her home safely. That is all I ask.
It happened during the night. Monsters from below took her before we could stop them. I need people who can go after her, not another explanation of why nobody noticed!
They took her into the dungeon beneath our town. I do not know how far down. Find her, and do not let your courage outrun your sense. She needs rescuers who can make it back.
Boric and Balin. Loyal lads. Very loyal. I would praise their powers of observation, but I am still waiting to observe them. For now, they are under strict orders to remain here.
